hero.summary: I'm a Security Engineer with over two years of experience in IT security engineering, security operations and GRC across cloud and enterprise environments, backed by a software engineering background in secure development.

intro.paragraph1: I'm a Security Engineer with over two years of experience in IT security engineering, security operations, and governance, risk and compliance (GRC) across cloud and enterprise environments.
intro.paragraph2: Currently I work as a Security Engineer within the DevOps team at Bettermile, where I focus on detecting threats early, managing vulnerabilities end to end, and building security into development workflows rather than adding it afterwards. Before moving into security, I worked as a Software Engineer, which helps me speak the same language as development teams and turn security requirements into practical solutions.

skills.mission: I want to detect threats earlier and build security in from the start, and I'm especially interested in how AI-driven technologies can strengthen cybersecurity.

highlights: Security monitoring, event analysis and alert triage.
Incident response across the full lifecycle, from detection and investigation to containment, remediation and post-incident improvements.
Vulnerability lifecycle management, from scanning to validated remediation.
ISMS development and maintenance aligned with ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, NIS2 and NIST CSF.
